decisions.reason: GA4 is now Google's only analytics standard, so the plugin fits the firm's shop-plugin direction and is cheap to maintain.
Google shut down Universal Analytics in 2023 and 2024, so its poor results cannot be blamed on temporary causes and no sunk cost justifies keeping a plugin for a dead platform.
A retail system interface plugin is part of the firm's integration offering, and its development investment and only recent launch favour patience.
The firm committed visibly to the SEO relaunch service with its own web page, and the service fits its core shop consulting business at low ongoing cost.
